answer_1.quote: We use LLMs (GPT-3), prompting them to create user summaries, as they have historically done well on this task ... The summary for each user is formed based on their Twitter profile and a sample of their tweets ...
answer_1.outputs: short textual summaries of each user describing their discussed topic and perspective

answer_4.quote: We use a single human interactor for all our experiments ... Humans were then asked to use their judgement and reasoning skills, something that is simple for them but hard for LLMs, to form initial validated communities ... Humans read the summaries, analyzing user perspective towards the entity.
answer_4.guideline: Humans read generated user summaries and decide whether users share the same perspective and should belong to the same information community.
